newsitem.title: USA: Black & Decker down on poor forecast.
newsitem.headline: Black & Decker down on poor forecast.

text.p: Black & Decker Corp's shares fell on Tuesday after the company forecast earnings below expectations, analysts said.
The power tool company's shares closed down 6-1/8 to 31-1/2 on volume of 4.4 million shares.
Black & Decker said Tuesday that fourth quarter and 1996 results would be below consensus estimates. Salomon Brothers contributed to the decline with a downgrade of the stock to hold from buy.
"I'm trying to figure out whether a $6 decline is enough," said Ken Gassmann, an analyst with Davenport & Co in Richmond, Va. "I love this company, but do I love it at $31?"
He said the shares were being pushed down because of the prospect of continued flat earnings.
Gassmann said a troubling part of the company's statement was that its first quarter 1997 earnings would be below that of the same period in 1996.
